response.rationale: The item is defective (arrived broken in three pieces) and not a final-sale item. RET-020 (priority 90) allows defective, non-final-sale items to be returned regardless of the standard window, which dominates RET-008 (priority 10) that would otherwise make the 37-day-old return ineligible. Final-sale (RET-012) and fraud-hold (RET-051) rules do not apply since final_sale and fraud_hold are false.
